source: measured from this repo's H01 data by scripts/scale_anchors.py

volume_block.how: bounding box of every cell body in the release's soma table

cortical_thickness.how: deepest reliable layer band, measured as distance to the pial surface

soma_spacing.how: distance from each cell body to its nearest neighbour, 5th to 95th percentile over all 49,379

cell_density.how: 49379 cell bodies in the 1.58 mm3 bounding box

arbor_extent.how: longest bounding box axis of each of the 104 proofread cells

cell_volume.how: reconstructed voxel count times the release's 8x8x33 nm voxel

cell_equivalent_diameter.how: diameter of a sphere of the same reconstructed volume

synapses_per_cell.how: release property NSI over the 104 proofread cells

spinyness.how: release property Sp over the 104 proofread cells

not_measured_here.synaptic_cleft: the release annotates 149,871,669 synapses but publishes no cleft width, so the map cites the literature
not_measured_here.ion_channel: far below the 4 nm imaging resolution
not_measured_here.conduction_speed: H01 is a fixed volume: it has no time axis at all
